cohort: 181 children with CP (aged 4-17 years at diagnosis)
finding: Maternal hypertension, neonatal convulsions, and delivery by cesarean section were associated with an increased risk of epilepsy and drug-resistant epilepsy in children with CP.
mod_finding: Delivery by cesarean section was associated with a two-fold increased risk of epilepsy in children with CP (OR = 2.17, p = 0.012).
